## Natural history notes

A medium-sized dove characterized by its gray body, darker head, iridescent green and purple sheen on the neck, pale wing patches, and two dark bars across the wings. In Florida, it is found mainly in urban and suburban areas, including cities, parks, bridges, buildings, farms, parking lots, and waterfronts where ledges or structures provide nesting sites. It feeds mostly on seeds, grains, and human-associated food, usually foraging on the ground in flocks and nesting year-round on buildings or other sheltered structures.
